proposedOverrides.summary: American Samoa has deep traditions of stoneworking, siapo barkcloth and community knowledge. Its eastern islands entered a US territorial relationship through a contested period of partition and separate cessions. Naval administration ended in 1951; Samoan cultural life and local institutions continue.
